components.name: Light Source
components.description: Halogen lamp or LED that provides the light beam for spectrophotometry

components.name: Entrance Slit
components.description: Narrows the beam of light to increase spectral resolution

components.name: Monochromator
components.description: Separates light into individual wavelengths using a prism or diffraction grating

components.name: Exit Slit
components.description: Allows only desired wavelengths to pass through to the sample

components.name: Cuvette Holder
components.description: Holds the sample cuvette in the light path for measurement

components.name: Detector (Photodiode)
components.description: Converts transmitted light into an electrical signal for measurement

components.name: Reference Beam Path
components.description: Beam path that allows for blank/reference measurements

components.name: Power Button
components.description: Turns the spectrophotometer on and off

components.name: Display Screen
components.description: LCD or digital display showing absorbance, transmittance, or wavelength readings

components.name: Keypad/Control Buttons
components.description: Buttons for input, menu navigation, and measurement control

components.name: Sample Compartment
components.description: External opening where cuvettes are inserted for measurement

components.name: Wavelength Selector
components.description: Dial or digital input to select measurement wavelength (typically 340-700 nm)

components.name: Data Port (USB/RS232)
components.description: Connection port for data transfer to computer or network

components.name: Power Cord
components.description: AC power supply connection for the instrument

components.name: Main Housing/Chassis
components.description: Protective enclosure containing all internal optical and electronic components
